'''Ada Klee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial Agent]] trainer during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. She trained the Imperial Agent [[Cipher Nine]].
